sources.similarity_basis: Industry descriptions and concepts present in the existing specialist BS/IS/CF files; no issuer-level coverage measurement performed.

assignment_status_definitions.explicit: Explicitly assigned in DONE.md; not a claim that all issuers or all facts have been validated.
assignment_status_definitions.provisional_fallback: Baseline assignment for initial coverage analysis; industry compatibility has not been established.
assignment_status_definitions.unknown_sic_fallback: Unknown SIC population; keep separate from known SIC coverage results.
assignment_status_definitions.similarity_candidate: Assigned provisionally to a specialist profile based on industry activity and shared statement concepts; compatibility is not yet measured and review_note identifies material differences.
assignment_status_definitions.company_override: An explicit company-level assignment keyed by 10-digit CIK; takes precedence over SIC and fallback without changing source SIC or facts.

notes: SIC codes are four-character strings; preserve leading zeroes.
Company counts are a snapshot of the source inventory, not verified DB import or mapping coverage.
This file selects an archetype directory, not a mapping_version_id. Consumers must explicitly select the intended imported definition version.
No importer or normalized_facts behavior changes merely because this file exists; integration must be implemented separately.
Known specialist assignments take precedence over fallback. Do not infer utility, insurance, banking or mining equivalence from a nearby SIC code.
All validation_status values start as not_assessed because per-SIC, per-issuer and per-statement coverage has not been measured by this table.

Similarity candidates select a closer existing specialist starting point, not a claim of equivalent financial statements or legal/tax status. All three statements currently use the same candidate profile; issuer overrides may be needed.
Assignment precedence: company_overrides by CIK, then SIC assignment, then the appropriate missing/unlisted SIC fallback. Overrides preserve stored source SIC.
